summary: Iteration 53: Comprehensive testing of Unified Pipeline Operations Panel - All features verified working correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Pipeline Operations features verified working. Route redirects configured correctly. State validation, WS debug, gate rules, override, exchange monitoring, and alert system all functional.

route_redirects.details: /admin/pipeline-control and /admin/pipeline-monitoring both redirect to /admin/pipeline-operations (verified in App.js lines 169-170)

legacy_links_removed.details: No legacy pipeline-control or pipeline-monitoring links in sidebar navigation

state_validation_endpoint.details: GET /api/runtime/state-validation returns real fields: ws_session_changed, override_effect_applied, gate_source, guard_block_visible, suggestions

state_validation_ui.details: State Validation Checklist shows PASS/FAIL badges with suggestions (e.g., 'WS reconnect session değişimi: FAIL' with action suggestion)

action_result_format.details: Action responses include status=success, trace_id, message, state_snapshot - verified via Manual Health Check button

ws_debug_fields.details: WS health response includes session_id, reconnect_count, last_error, reconnect_reason, recent_reconnect_reasons (max 5)

release_gate_rules.details: Gate status returns rules[] with rule_id, result (PASS/FAIL), message, fix_hint - 6 fix_hint links visible in UI

override_enriched_fields.details: Override/active returns ttl_remaining_seconds, impacted_trades_count, max_ttl_minutes, total_impacted_trades

exchange_monitoring.details: Exchange monitoring returns drift_details, connection_details, trend - UI shows drift table

mode_indicator.details: MODE: PAPER visible in Pipeline Operations header and Live Trading Dashboard (current_mode: PAPER)

alert_system.details: Alerts history supports severity, time, event filters - UI shows severity badges (CRITICAL, INFO) with Resolve/Mute/Escalate actions
